nodes.name: List Source Files
nodes.notes: Reads all PDFs from /files. Change the glob pattern or replace with HTTP Request, Google Drive, S3, etc.

nodes.name: Hash & Dedup Check
nodes.notes: Computes SHA-256 hash, dedup via workflow static data. Requires NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto and N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED=false in n8n config.

nodes.name: Is Skipped?
nodes.notes: True = already processed (skip to summary). False = new document (send to ingest).

nodes.name: Track Poll Count
nodes.notes: Limits polling to 60 iterations (5 minutes). Changes status to 'timeout' when exceeded.
